items.title: Mike Wofford interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: And I finally got with him when I was about twelve or thirteen. His name was Bill Franks and he’s since deceased but he taught here for many years.

ctx.x: So from hearing these records and then deciding that this is something that I want to try to do, how did you teach yourself how to play jazz?

Well I pretty much did myself. I had a series of, I started early studying which was fortunate, at about seven, but generally it was neighborhood piano teachers which in those days there was a piano teacher in almost every block, you know it was very common, part time piano teachers. There were pianos in most homes, or many homes anyway, and it was much more common to find pianos in someone’s living room. And so I studied with a series of okay beginning teachers. But I’ve always regretted I never had one that was…
